reports.performance: Vsynced to 60 fps, sometimes drops to ~40
reports.notes: I wasn't playing for long, so I can't say much about overheating, etc. But after running two different maps for about 30 minutes in total, the FPS was fine most of the time, with some occasional spikes. I used Max settings with pixelation turned to the minimum. And yeah, maybe there is a subtle input lag, but it's totally bearable.
